αἰθομένοις: αἴθω — kindle, burn; pres. part. pass. neut. dat. pl.: ’burning’ (agreeing with ἱεροῖσιν)
αἵδε: ὅδε, ἥδε, τόδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., fem. nom. pl., agreeing with βόες: ’these (cattle)’
βιάζετε: βιάζω — use force on, press hard; pres. 2 pl. act. (+ acc.): ’you press (me)’
βοσκέσκονθ: βόσκω — feed; mid. graze; impf. 3 pl. mid., iterative -εσκ-, unaugmented, elided (βοσκέσκονθ’ = βοσκέσκοντο, Attic ἐβόσκοντο): ’they were grazing’
βουλῆς: βουλή — counsel, plan, design; fem. gen. sg., Ionic η (= Attic βουλῆς), with ἐξήρχετο
βούλομ: βούλομαι — wish, prefer; pres. 1 sg. mid., elided (βούλομ’ = βούλομαι): ’I prefer’ (with ἤ ’rather than’)
γίγνετ: γίγνομαι — become, arise, come to be; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented, elided (γίγνετ’ = γίγνετο, Attic ἐγίγνετο): ’arose’
δεινοῦ: δεινός — dread, awful, terrible; masc. gen. sg., agreeing with θεοῦ
δηλήματα: δήλημα — bane, destroyer, harm; neut. nom. pl., in apposition with ἄνεμοι: ’bane’
διαρραίουσι: διαρραίω — shatter utterly, wreck; pres. 3 pl. act. (ῥαίω with δια-, ρ doubled after the prefix)
δρεψάμενοι: δρέπω — pluck, gather; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. pl.: ’having plucked’
δρυὸς: δρῦς — oak; fem. gen. sg.: ’of an oak’
δυσαέος: δυσαής — ill-blowing, of foul wind; masc. gen. sg., epic uncontracted -έος (= Attic -οῦς), epithet of Zephyrus
εἰσερύσαντες: εἰσερύω — drag in, haul in; aor. part. act. masc. nom. pl., epic (= Attic εἰσελκύσαντες): ’having dragged in’
εὐξαίμην: εὔχομαι — pray, vow; aor. opt. mid. 1 sg., in a purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’I might pray’
εὕρωμεν: εὑρίσκω — find; aor. subj. act. 1 pl., in an εἴ κε clause: ’we find, we should find’
ζαῆν: ζαής — blowing hard, stormy (ζα- intensive); masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ἄνεμον
θεῖμεν: τίθημι — put, place, set up; aor. opt. act. 1 pl. (= θείημεν), with κε, potential: ’we would set up’
θόωκοι: θόωκος — seat; masc. nom. pl., epic (= Attic θῶκοι, θᾶκοι)
κάμνεις: κάμνω — toil, grow weary; pres. 2 sg. act.: ’you grow weary’
κακῇσιν: κακός — bad, evil; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic -αῖς), agreeing with ἀτασθαλίῃσι
καλοὶ: καλός — beautiful, fair, fine; masc. nom. pl., agreeing with χοροί
κλαιόντεσσι: κλαίω — weep; pres. part. act. masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic κλαίουσι): ’to them weeping’
κνίσης: κνῖσα (epic κνίση) — savour of burning fat; fem. gen. sg., Ionic η (= Attic κνίσης): ’of the fat’
λαρὸν: λαρός — tasty, pleasant; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with δόρπον
λεῖψαι: λείβω — pour, pour as a libation; aor. inf. act. (μέθυ λεῖψαι ’to pour wine’)
λιλαιόμενοι: λιλαίομαι — long for, desire (+ gen.); pres. part. mid. masc. nom. pl.: ’longing for’
μνησάμενοι: μιμνήσκω — remind; mid. remember, call to mind; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. pl.: ’having remembered’
νηὸν: ναός (epic νηός) — temple, shrine; masc. acc. sg. (= Attic ναόν)
νυκτῶν: νύξ — night; fem. gen. pl.: ’of the nights’
νυμφέων: νύμφη — nymph; fem. gen. pl., Ionic -έων (= Attic -ῶν)
νότου: Νότος — the South Wind, personified; masc. gen. sg.
πάθωμεν: πάσχω — suffer, experience; aor. subj. 1 pl., after μή: ’lest we suffer’
περί: περί — around, about; adv. ’exceedingly, beyond others’ (περί τοι μένος ’you have strength beyond others’)
περίστησάν: περιίστημι — set around; aor. 3 pl. act., unaugmented (= Attic περιέστησαν): ’they stood (them) around’
πῶυ: πῶυ — flock (of sheep); neut. acc. sg., epic
σπένδοντες: σπένδω — pour a libation; pres. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’pouring a libation’
στήσαμεν: ἵστημι — set up, make stand; aor. 1 pl. act., unaugmented (= Attic ἐστήσαμεν): ’we stood (the ship) at moorings’
στρεύγεσθαι: στρεύγομαι — be worn out, waste away; pres. inf. mid./pass.: ’to be worn away’
στυγεροὶ: στυγερός — hateful, loathsome; masc. nom. pl.
σχέτλιός: σχέτλιος — cruel, hard, unyielding; masc. nom. sg., predicate, with accent from the enclitic εἰς
τέρενα: τέρην, τέρεινα, τέρεν — tender, soft; neut. acc. pl., agreeing with φύλλα
τελεύτησάν: τελευτάω — bring to an end, complete; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἐτελεύτησαν): ’they completed’
τετυκοίμεθα: τεύχω — make, prepare; aor. opt. mid. 1 pl., epic reduplicated aorist (τετυκ-): ’we might prepare’
τετύκοντο: τεύχω — make, prepare; aor. 3 pl. mid., epic reduplicated aorist, unaugmented (= Attic ἐτεύξαντο): ’they prepared’
τεύξομεν: τεύχω — make, build; fut. 1 pl. (or short-vowel aor. subj. with κεν): ’we will build’
φήνειε: φαίνω — show, reveal; aor. opt. act. 3 sg., in a wish-condition after εἴ: ’might show’
χανὼν: χάσκω — gape, open the mouth wide; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’gaping’
χολωσάμενός: χολόω — anger; mid. be angered; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., accent from the enclitic τι: ’having been angered’
χοροὶ: χορός — dancing-place, dance; masc. nom. pl.
ἀγάλματα: ἄγαλμα — ornament, glory, offering to a god; neut. acc. pl.
ἀθανάτη: ἀθάνατος — immortal, deathless; fem. nom. sg., epic -η (= Attic ἀθάνατος, two-ending), epithet of Circe
ἀλητεύοντες: ἀλητεύω — wander, roam about; pres. part. act. masc. nom. pl.
ἀμφήλυθεν: ἀμφέρχομαι — come around, envelop; aor. 3 sg., epic ἀμφήλυθε(ν) (= Attic ἀμφῆλθε), with movable ν
ἀνάκτων: ἄναξ — lord, master; masc. gen. pl. (θεῶν ἀνάκτων ’of the lord gods’)
ἀπέστιχον: ἀποστείχω — go away, depart; impf. 1 sg.: ’I went off’
ἀπέχοντο: ἀπέχω — hold off; mid. keep away from (+ gen.); impf. 3 pl. mid.: ’they held off’
ἀπεχώμεθα: ἀπέχω — hold off; mid. keep away from (+ gen.); pres. subj. mid. 1 pl., hortatory: ’let us keep away’
ἀποκτάνῃ: ἀποκτείνω — kill; aor. subj. 3 sg. (epic 2nd aor. -κτάν-; Attic aor. ἀπέκτεινα), after μή: ’let him (not) kill’
ἀποπλαγχθέντας: ἀποπλάζω — drive off course; aor. part. pass. masc. acc. pl.: ’driven off course’
ἀπώμνυον: ἀπόμνυμι — swear, take an oath; impf. 3 pl.: ’they swore’
ἀρίστας: ἄριστος — best; fem. acc. pl.: ’the best (cattle)’
ἀτασθαλίῃσι: ἀτασθαλία — reckless folly, wantonness; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αις), instrumental: ’through folly’
ἀυτμή: ἀυτμή — breath, vapour, blast; fem. nom. sg.: ’vapour’
ἁδηκότας: ἁδέω — be sated, worn out (+ dat.); perf. part. act. masc. acc. pl., epic: ’worn out’
ἄγρην: ἄγρη — hunting, game, catch; fem. acc. sg.
ἄη: ἄημι — blow; impf. 3 sg., epic uncontracted, unaugmented (= Attic ἄη, ἔπνει): ’blew’
ἄλληκτος: ἄληκτος — unceasing; masc. nom. sg., epic doubled λ, agreeing with Νότος: ’unceasing’
ἄνωγας: ἄνωγα — bid, command (perf. with present sense); perf. 2 sg., epic: ’you bid’
ἐθέλῃ: ἐθέλω — be willing, wish; pres. subj. 3 sg., in an εἰ clause without κε: ’is willing’
ἐλάσαντες: ἐλαύνω — drive, drive off; aor. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’having driven off’
ἐξέταμον: ἐκτάμνω — cut out; aor. 3 pl., epic 2nd aor. (= Attic ἐξέτεμον): ’they cut out’
ἐξήρχετο: ἐξάρχω — lead off; mid. begin (+ gen.); impf. 3 sg. mid.: ’began’
ἐξαπέβησαν: ἐξαποβαίνω — disembark; aor. 3 pl., augment inside the double prefix: ’they disembarked’
ἐπώπτων: ἐποπτάω — roast, grill; impf. 3 pl., contracted: ’they roasted’
ἐρήμῃ: ἐρῆμος — desert, uninhabited; fem. dat. sg.
ἐυσσέλμου: ἐύσσελμος — well-benched; two-ending adj., fem. gen. sg., epic -ου (= Attic -ου), with νηός
ἐφέπεσκον: ἐφέπω — go after, pursue; impf. 3 pl., iterative -εσκ- (Attic would use the plain impf. ἐφέπον): ’they kept going after’
ἔγκατα: ἔγκατα — entrails, innards; neut. nom./acc. pl. (only plural)
ἔδειραν: δέρω — flay; aor. 3 pl. act.: ’they flayed’
ἔκλαιον: κλαίω — weep, weep for; impf. 3 pl. (+ acc.): ’they wept for’
ἔσφαξαν: σφάζω — slaughter, cut the throat of; aor. 3 pl. act.: ’they slaughtered’
ἔφαγε: ἐσθίω — eat; aor. 3 sg. ἔφαγον (suppletive stem φαγ-), with movable ε (= ἔφαγε(ν)): ’ate’
ἕκηλοι: ἕκηλος — at ease, undisturbed; masc. nom. pl.
ἕλικες: ἕλιξ — twisted, curved; of cattle, with curved horns; masc./fem. nom. pl., agreeing with βόες
ἕσπωνται: ἕπομαι — follow; aor. subj. mid. 3 pl., epic σπ- aorist (= Attic ἕπωνται), in tmesis with ἐπί: ’they follow’
ἠρώμην: ἀράομαι — pray, pray to; impf. 1 sg. mid., contracted (ἠρώμην for ἠρᾱόμην): ’I prayed’
ἡδὺς: ἡδύς — sweet, pleasant; masc. nom. sg., used with the fem. noun ἀυτμή
ἤλυξα: ἀλύσκω — escape, slip away from; aor. 1 sg., epic (Attic would use ἔφυγον): ’I eluded’
ἱεροῖσιν: ἱερός — holy; neut. ἱερά, sacrificial offerings; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οῖς)
ὀλέσαι: ὄλλυμι — destroy, ruin; aor. inf. act. (= Attic ἀπολέσαι): ’to destroy’
ὀλέσσαι: ὄλλυμι — destroy, lose; aor. inf. act., epic σσ (= ὀλέσαι), in tmesis with ἀπό: ’to lose (my life)’
ὀμόσσατε: ὄμνυμι — swear; aor. imper. act. 2 pl., epic σσ (= Attic ὀμόσατε): ’swear!’
ὀρθοκραιράων: ὀρθόκραιρα — straight-horned; fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν), with βοῶν
ὁπλισόμεσθα: ὁπλίζω — make ready; mid. prepare for oneself; aor. subj. mid. 1 pl., short vowel, epic -μεσθα (= Attic -μεθα): ’let us prepare’
ὄμοσάν: ὄμνυμι — swear; aor. 3 pl. act., unaugmented (= Attic ὤμοσαν): ’they had sworn’
ὄρνιθάς: ὄρνις — bird; masc./fem. acc. pl., accent from the enclitic τε
ὑπεκφύγοι: ὑπεκφεύγω — escape from; aor. opt. act. 3 sg., potential with κέν: ’might escape’
ὑψικόμοιο: ὑψίκομος — high-crowned, with lofty foliage; fem. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), with δρυός
ὡρμίσαμεν: ὁρμίζω — bring to anchor, moor; aor. 1 pl. act.: ’we moored’
ᾔνεον: αἰνέω — praise, approve; impf. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ᾔνουν), in tmesis with ἐπί: ’they approved’

__broaden__.κέ: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν); accented before an enclitic · also + subj. in a purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’so that’ (ὄφρα κέ τοι λύσῃ ’so that she may free’) · also + subj. in the protasis after αἴ: ’if perhaps’ (αἴ κέ ποθι Ζεὺς δώῃ ’if Zeus should somehow grant’) · also + subj. in the protasis after εἴ: ’if perhaps’ (εἴ κέ τιν’ … εὕρωμεν ’if we should find any’)
__broaden__.κεν: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν) · also + secondary indic. (κατέφθιτο), unreal past conditional: ’would have perished’ · also + aor. indic. of a future event pictured as already accomplished, an eventual near-certainty rather than a counterfactual: ἤ κεν ... κτεῖνεν ’or he may well have killed (him) already’ · also + subj. in a relative clause, prospective: ’who is to, who will’ (ἥ κεν ἄγῃσι ’(a wagon) that shall carry’) · also + opt. in a purpose clause: ’so that’ (ὥς κεν … γένοιτο ’so that he might become’) · also + subj. in a temporal clause: ’whenever’ (ὅτε κεν … δαινύῃ ’whenever you feast’) · also + subj. in the protasis of a condition after αἴ: ’if ever’ · also + opt., potential: ’might, may’ · also + opt. in the protasis after εἰ: ’if ever’ (εἰ δέ κεν … ἀφικοίμεθα ’but if we should reach’) · also + fut. indic. or short-vowel subj. in an apodosis: ’will’ (αἶψά κεν … τεύξομεν ’at once we will build’)
__broaden__.ἔστιν: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 sg., impersonal: ’it is possible’ · also plain copula, personal: ’is’ (ἀργύρεος ... ἔστιν ἅπας ’it is entirely silver’) · also with a dat. of the possessor, ’have’ (ἅσσα μοι ἔστιν ’whatever I have’) · also existential, ’there is’ (ἐν … νηὶ … βρῶσίς τε πόσις τε ἔστιν ’in the ship there is food and drink’)
__broaden__.ἔπι: ἐπί — on, upon, over; prep. + dat., placed after its noun with anastrophe: ἑοῖς ἔπι ’upon his own (possessions)’ · also + gen., postpositive with anastrophe, of direction: ’toward’ (νήσου ἔπι Ψυρίης ’toward the island of Psyria’) · also as adverb with no case expressed, intensifying repetition: ’besides, again’ (ἔπι δεύτερον αὖτις ’a second time, once more’) · also = ἔπεστι, accented on the first syllable when it stands for the verb: ’there is (upon)’ · also as preverb in tmesis, placed after its object: ἔπι … ὦρσεν = ἐπῶρσεν ’stirred up (against)’
__broaden__.μῆλον: μῆλον — apple; neut. nom. sg. · also μῆλον — sheep, small-stock animal; neut. acc. sg., object of a verb (ἠέ τι μῆλον ’or any sheep’)
__broaden__.ὃ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (relative) — who, which; neut. nom./acc. sg., referring to a person: ’that he...’ · also masc. nom. sg. relative, ’who’, used in address with a 2nd person verb (ὃ χθιζὸς θεὸς ἤλυθες ’you who came yesterday as a god’) · also pron. ’he’, masc. nom. sg. (ἧος ὃ … μιγείη) · also neut. acc. sg. relative, referring back to a thing, object of δῶκας: ’which (you gave me)’ · also = ὅτι ’that’, neut. acc. sg., introducing a clause after a verb of knowing (ὃ δὴ κακὰ μήδετο ’that evils were being devised’)
__broaden__.φίλας: φίλος — dear, own; fem. acc. pl., agreeing with the dual χεῖρε: ’dear (hands)’ · also fem. acc. pl., agreeing with χεῖρας: ’dear (hands)’
__broaden__.εὐχετόωντο: εὐχετάομαι — declare oneself, avow, boast; impf. 3 pl., epic diectasis (by-form of εὔχομαι) · also pray, make a vow: ’they prayed’ (εὐχετόωντο θεοῖσιν ’they prayed to the gods’)
__broaden__.πάντ: πᾶς — all, every; neut. acc. pl. (elided πάντ’): ’everything’ · also masc. acc. sg., elided, agreeing with μῆνα: ’the whole (month)’
__broaden__.μετὰ: μετά — among, with, after; prep. + dat./acc./gen. · with acc. also ’in quest of, in search of’ (μετὰ χαλκόν ’after bronze’) · also a plain adverb, no case governed: ’besides, in addition’ · also adverb, ’among them, in their midst’: μετὰ δὲ πρέπει ἀγρομένοισιν ’and he stands out among the gathered’ · also as preverb in tmesis (μετὰ … βεβήκει = μεταβεβήκει ’had moved on, passed on’)
__broaden__.ἑταῖροι: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. nom. pl. · also voc. pl. (same form), address: ’companions!’
__broaden__.θεοῦ: θεός — god; masc. gen. sg., genitive with a verb of hearing · also genitive governed by a preposition (ἄνευ θεοῦ ’without a god’) · also possessive genitive with a noun: ’of the god’ (θεοῦ δαῖτα) · also gen. with ἄρχομαι, ’from the god’ (the point of departure) · also masc. gen. sg. used of a goddess (the masc. form serves either sex): θεοῦ εὐνήν ’a goddess’s bed’ · also predicate genitive of possession: ’belonging to a god’ (δεινοῦ γὰρ θεοῦ αἵδε βόες ’these cattle are a dread god’s’)
__broaden__.μοι: ἐγώ — I; encl. dat. sg.: ’to me, for me’ · also dat. of the person affected, ’from my …’ (μοι βλεφάρων ἐξέσσυτο ὕπνος ’sleep rushed out from my eyelids’)
__broaden__.γεγώνευν: γεγωνέω — shout, call out to; impf. 3 pl., epic uncontracted, unaugmented (= Attic ἐγεγώνουν) · also impf. 1 sg. (same form): ’I cried out’
